chunks: Indeed, a servant has a certain rank with Allah (Glorified is His Majesty) that he does not attain except by one of two characteristics: either by an affliction in his body or by the loss of his wealth.
ai.seo_question: How do physical illness and loss of wealth affect a believer's spiritual rank with Allah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) explains that a believer attains a specific high rank with Allah through one of two means: enduring physical illness or losing their wealth. These afflictions serve as a means of elevation in the divine presence.
